reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides configurable audio notifications for agent, turn, tool, approval, and session events, with manual playback controls and hot-reloaded settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 事件提供可配置的音效提示，并支持试听、停止和保存即热重载设置。
summaries.en: Provides configurable sound notifications for DeepSeek Harness events with manual playback controls and hot-reloaded settings.

capabilities: Plays configured audio files when DeepSeek Harness events occur
Reads user sound settings and hot-reloads configuration
Provides slash commands to list, play, and stop sounds
